name: spawn
js: (async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000));let n=0;const t=performance.now();const fr=[];let last=t;await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){const now=performance.now();fr.push(now-last);last=now;n++;if(now-t<5000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});fr.sort((a,b)=>a-b);console.log('[bench] spawn '+((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(2)+' ms p95 '+fr[Math.floor(fr.length*0.95)].toFixed(2))})()
